items.title: Harrison Barnes Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: And we had ten pieces that night. Yeah, Robeshow got a couple more other pieces.

ctx.x: West End Roof, wasn't it? Huh? West End Roof, wasn't it? I think it was. I think that's the name of it. They had so many different places I'd get confused if I'm trying to take a show. Yeah, anyway, West End. Yeah, there's a player there, and they used to come on. They still sound good on that water, at night in band, that music still sound nice out there. Late at night, you know. And you could play too. They could play. We'd come on in. We'd catch a call right there in the West End call and bring us in town. And…
